title: GFN2-XTB + energy-derived X-H Delta(ZAFF) HDCPT2 fundamentals
summary: Build composite harmonic F2 from the frozen v4 two-Morse primitive field, acquire raw resident GFN2-XTB F3/F4, and compute HDCPT2 fundamentals and effective x without a variational stage.
gates: v4 two-Morse field has the approved fit hash, zero ZAFF reference energy, zero charges and no nonbonded terms
zero ZAFF reference energy, charges and nonbonded terms
identical atom order and geometry for composite F2 and GFN2 F3/F4
converged GFN2 SCC and analytic-Hessian CPSCF
positive active harmonic frequencies or explicit harmonic-mode treatment
finite and symmetric effective x matrix
GFN2 electronic temperature is fixed at 0 K, matching the v4 fitted baseline
coordinate_policy: Freeze the reference geometry and mass-weighted composite F2 modes; acquire raw GFN2 F3/F4 in that basis.
backend_policy: Use the resident GFN2Calculator analytic Hessian at 0 K, the electronic temperature used by the v4 fitted composite baseline. Acquire raw GFN2 F3/F4 on the composite F2 normal modes.
